sectionSubtitle: Exploring operational web applications, event digital platforms, and production inventory systems built with Laravel and Next.js.

items.title: SPMS Lapas Empat Lawang
items.client: Lembaga Pemasyarakatan Kelas IIB Empat Lawang, South Sumatra
items.summary: Developed and deployed a Laravel/MySQL operational web application supporting QR-based roll calls, location-assisted security checks, housing records, approvals, and reports.
highlights: Developed and deployed a Laravel/MySQL operational web application supporting QR-based roll calls, location-assisted security checks, housing records, approvals, and reports.
Developed responsive desktop/mobile interfaces for officers and administrators, connecting QR and GPS-assisted workflows to application data.
Configured and maintained production hosting, domain, HTTPS, MySQL, SMTP, and scheduled jobs; supported post-launch improvements.

items.title: Fotodarikamu
items.summary: Developing an event-based digital camera platform with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and MySQL/MariaDB with QR-code guest camera flows and Midtrans/DOKU QRIS payments.
highlights: Developing an event-based digital camera platform with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and MySQL/MariaDB.
Built user-facing event and QR-code guest camera flows plus an administration dashboard for account and event management.
Integrated QRIS payment flows through Midtrans/DOKU and transaction-status webhooks.

items.title: Kantong Jamu
items.summary: Built a Laravel/MySQL production and inventory management application integrating production records, stock tracking, Bill of Materials, QC approval, and activity-based payroll.
highlights: Built a Laravel/MySQL production and inventory management application integrating production records, stock tracking, Bill of Materials, and distribution.
Developed operational business logic for QC approval and activity-based payroll calculations; tested and refined application features.

items.title: QR & GPS Officer Roll Call
items.summary: Mobile-ready officer roll call and location-verified security patrol workflow integrated into the central SPMS dashboard.
highlights: Connected dynamic QR checkpoints and GPS location verification directly to officer duty rosters.
Automated daily supervisor approval and PDF/tabular operational reporting.

items.title: QRIS Webhook Payment Engine
items.summary: Automated QRIS checkout and asynchronous webhook reconciliation using Midtrans and DOKU for instant event activation.
highlights: Built Midtrans and DOKU QRIS payment initiation and signature-verified status webhooks.
Automated event quota provisioning upon settlement notification.

items.title: BoM & QC Payroll Engine
items.summary: Multi-stage Bill of Materials stock deduction paired with Quality Control approval gates and activity-based worker payroll.
highlights: Implemented automatic raw-material deduction based on Bill of Materials recipes.
Linked approved QC production batches directly to activity-based payroll calculations.
